topic: Adding dynamic slot and loop duration parameters
summary_markdown: Someone implemented dynamic slot duration functionality in a separate branch. This involved adding two new parameters, `slot_duration` and `loop_duration`, to the calls made to `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` and `/api/campaigns/report/screens`. These new parameters are optional (only included if set on the UI). The existing payload parameters (`slots` and `loops`) will remain untouched, maintaining their original names and function as counts. [me] confirmed that this approach is acceptable.
decisions: The new dynamic duration parameters (`slot_duration`, `loop_duration`) will be added to the API calls without modifying existing payload structure.
